sketches.mechanism: Ownership move invalidates a binding; using the value after it has been moved is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What is surrendered remains named, but the name can no longer summon it.

sketches.mechanism: The uninhabited Void type and absurd allow a function from impossibility to any type, but no value can call it.
sketches.resonance: Absence can promise everything because it never has to arrive.
